013033** A2K-ACCEPT-TODAYS-DATE.                                     ** 000700      
013034** This Paragraph accepts the TODAYS-DATE from System in Long  ** 000800      
013035** Format e.g. MM/DD/CCAA. And it converts into a numeric      ** 000900      
013036** date MMDDCCAA, which is returned into the variable          ** 001000      
013037** A2K-FEC-MDCA-001.                                           ** 001100      
013038***************************************************************** 001200      
013039                                                                  001300      
013040 A2K-ACCEPT-TODAYS-DATE.                                          001400      
013041        MOVE ZEROES TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-001.                          001500      
013042*       MOVE "    " TO A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA.                          001600      
013043        ACCEPT A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA FROM TODAYS-DATE.                 001700      
013044        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-MM TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-MM-001.          001800      
013045        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-DD TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-DD-001.          001900      
013046        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-CC TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-CC-001.          002000      
013047        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-AA TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-AA-001.          002100      
013048                                                                  002200

013053** A2K-CONV-AMD-TO-CAMD.                                      **  002700      
013054**This Paragraph converts a SIX digit date in AAMMDD format to**  002800      
013055**an EIGHT digit format as CCAAMMDD. It uses a                **  002900      
013056**baseyear to add the century to the year part.               **  003000      
013057**INPUT is A2K-FEC-AMD-001                                    **  003100      
013058**OUTPUT is A2K-FEC-CAMD-001                                  **  003200      
013059****************************************************************  003300      
013060                                                                  003400

013064         IF A2K-FEC-AMD-001 = 0                                   003720      
013065            MOVE ZEROES TO A2K-FEC-CAMD-001                       003740      
013066         ELSE                                                     003741      
013067          IF A2K-FEC-AMD-001 = 999999                             003742      
013068             MOVE 99999999 TO A2K-FEC-CAMD-001                    003743      
013069         ELSE                                                     003760      
013070         PERFORM A2K-OBTAIN-CENTURY THRU                          003800      
013071                 A2K-OBTAIN-CENTURY-EXIT                          003900      
013072         MOVE A2K-FEC-YEAR-CC TO A2K-FEC-CAMD-CC-001              004000      
013073         MOVE A2K-FEC-AMD-AA-001 TO A2K-FEC-CAMD-AA-001           004100      
013074         MOVE A2K-FEC-AMD-MM-001 TO A2K-FEC-CAMD-MM-001           004200
